title: Letters in focus
text: In the story, who knows the other characters?
Who do not know each other?
Imagine you are Bobby. Introduce Max and Willy to Tina.
Read the story again and find the letters “Ll”, “Mm” and “Nn”.
Listen, point and say the letters.
